 Prisoners Writer Aaron Guzikowski Is Scripting a New Alien Film at 20th Century Studios

 Aaron Guzikowski, the screenwriter who created the HBO Max series Raised by Wolves, is writing a new Alien movie for 20th Century Studios, Deadline confirmed on October 23. Deadline described the film as being in very early development.
 The Hollywood Reporter was first with the news. Its exclusive, by senior film writer Borys Kit, went up that afternoon, and Deadline's confirmation followed under the byline of senior film reporter Matt Grobar.
 Little else about the project has been made public. Deadline said it is unclear whether the film would follow Alien: Romulus, the 2024 release and the franchise's most recent installment.
 Producers and Studio Oversight
 Ridley Scott and Michael Pruss will produce the film for Scott Free, the production company behind Raised by Wolves. J.R. Young is overseeing the project on behalf of 20th Century Studios.
 Guzikowski's Credits
 Guzikowski is an American screenwriter and showrunner. Raised by Wolves aired for two seasons and followed two androids raising human children after a great war destroyed Earth.
 He is otherwise best known for writing Prisoners, a 2013 crime thriller from Warner Bros. directed by Denis Villeneuve. Deadline listed those two projects as his main credits in its report.
 The Franchise
 Deadline calls Alien an iconic sci-fi horror series. It centers on humanity's deadly encounters with an extraterrestrial species known as the Xenomorph.
 Fede Álvarez directed Alien: Romulus, which grossed more than $350 million worldwide. That is the most recent film in the series, and the new project has not been tied to it in any published report.
 Early Reaction Online
 Film-news accounts on X spread word of the project within hours. Several described it as connected to Prometheus and Alien is that Covenant, which are earlier films in the series.
 Deadline's account leaves open how the new film relates to any earlier installment. No director has been named in the material Deadline published.
